## Goal

Describe the user, product, or engineering outcome this roadmap item should achieve.

## Scope

- [ ] List the major capabilities, milestones, or decisions that belong in this roadmap item.

## Dependencies / related work

Link related roadmap issues, audit findings, prerequisites, or sequencing constraints. State when none are known.

## Non-goals / boundaries

Call out important exclusions, deferred work, or architectural constraints that should not be lost when this is split into implementation issues.

## Implementation notes

Record useful design direction, research gates, rollout constraints, or validation expectations. Keep this at roadmap level rather than turning the epic into one oversized implementation task.

This is a roadmap/planning epic. Implementation should be split into focused issues/PRs where practical.
